message.content:
This editorial illustration is the cover of a magazine titled "TEMPO" in large, black, serif capital letters. Below the title, smaller text reads "EDISI 3-9 JUNI 2013". At the top, white text on a light background states "LAPORAN KHUSUS: 100 TAHUN SANG PENDEKAR KEADILAN". The central subject is a stylized, hand-drawn portrait of an elderly man with glasses, light-colored hair, and a smiling expression. He wears a dark jacket over a white collared shirt with a dark tie. The illustration uses shades of beige, brown, and black with visible brushstrokes and ink-splatter effects in the background.

To the right of the portrait, large black text reads "BECERMIN PADA YAP THIAM HIEN". In the bottom right corner, there is a barcode, the price "RP 33.000", the website "WWW.TEMPO.CO", and "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN ISSN: 0126-4273". A red vertical band runs down the left edge, and a red horizontal band is at the bottom. The background has a textured, parchment-like appearance.
